name: `shoptet dev` command
description:
Wire dev-engine (proxy, injection, HMR, overlay, version assertion, production warning) into the CLI as the shoptet dev command. Expose a queryable state API from dev-engine (rendered-version assertion, snapshot diffs, build state) so a future MCP server or VS Code extension can be a thin client over the same internals instead of a parallel implementation.

No drift warnings (need a clean reference shop, Phase 4/5) and no telemetry (Phase 7) in this command yet.

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §5.5, §9.
